bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to energy; prohibiting a local ban on new natural gas hookups in residential construction; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 326B.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[326B.441] NATURAL GAS BAN; PROHIBITION. +]

[+A political subdivision must not adopt local regulations prohibiting the use of natural gas as an energy source in a residential unit after July 1, 2025. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to energy; prohibiting a local ban on new natural gas hookups in residential construction; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 326B.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[326B.441] NATURAL GAS BAN; PROHIBITION.

A political subdivision must not adopt local regulations prohibiting the use of natural gas as an energy source in a residential unit after July 1, 2025.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: A political subdivision must not adopt local regulations prohibiting the use of natural gas as an energy source in a residential unit after July 1, 2025.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
